extra.message: payroll_bundle_thaw_170 calls pickle.loads() on raw bytes taken directly from the request body (optionally base64-decoded per the `wrap` param). cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: payroll_xml_fold_454 parses the raw request body as XML using an lxml.etree.XMLParser configured with load_dtd=True and resolve_entities=True (and no_network=False). cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: payroll_jinja_cast_384 builds a Jinja2 Template by concatenating the raw `fragment` query parameter into the template source string and rendering it. This is classic Server-Side Template Injection: a request like `?fragment={{ self.__init__.__globals__.__builtins__.__import__('os').popen('id').read() }}` can achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
CWE-94: Code Injection

extra.message: payroll_formula_cast_252 passes the user-controlled `expr` query parameter directly to eval(). Although __builtins__ is restricted to {}, this style of restricted eval() is a well-known incomplete sandbox and can typically be escaped via object introspection (e.g. through string/format/generator attribute chains) to reach arbitrary code execution; at minimum it allows arbitrary Python expression evaluation and resource exhaustion.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code

extra.message: payroll_mongo_lane_413 takes the JSON-decoded request body's `filter` field (or the whole body) and passes it unvalidated as the query document to MongoClient(...).ops.records.find_one(query). An attacker fully controls the Mongo query operators (e.g. `$where`, `$regex`), enabling NoSQL injection to bypass filters, cause denial of service, or exfiltrate data via server-side JS execution in `$where`.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: payroll_dock_shelf_391 builds a filesystem path by joining BASE_EXPORT_DIR with the unsanitized `name` query parameter and writes the raw request body to it (target.write_bytes). extra.message: payroll_fold_drop_014 joins BASE_EXPORT_DIR with the unsanitized `packet_ref` query parameter and reads it with parcel_path.read_text(), with no check that the resolved path stays inside BASE_EXPORT_DIR. cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: payroll_broker_tile_015 passes the user-supplied `url` query parameter directly to urllib.request.urlopen() with no scheme/host allowlist.
